notes.title: Summer in Mara has been updated with a new language and bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Today, we are happy to announce that Summer in Mara has been updated.

First of all, a new language has been added to the game. Now, you can take of your island and meet the inhabitants of Mara in Japanese and Chinese (simplified)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/1eee1d9a989b824bbb4e3f492f28e2e111d774e1.jpg

We expect these new languages will help Japanese players to find the story of Summer in Mara more enjoyable ^-^

Also, this new patch fixes different gameplay and aesthetic bugs that were hindering the game. We hope these improvements will help to have a better experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/76bddb909f67315394cde012f44a6d4b5273a2ec.jpg

Finally, this week marks the anniversary of the release of Summer in Mara. It's been two years since the release of our most successful game and it has been an incredible journey. Thank you very much for all your support! 

To celebrate, we have prepared different sales and events, including physical editions giveaways. Be sure to stay tuned on our social media profiles this week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/962580/Summer_in_Mara/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1623700/Deiland_Pocket_Planet/

And if you are one of those who already player Summer in Mara (thank you! <3) there is more to come! Check out Koa and the Five Pirates of Mara, a new game which continues the story of Koa after the events of the first game. A demo will be released today for the Steam Next Fest, perfect chance to give a try! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1819450/Koa_and_the_Five_Pirates_of_Mara/?ref=sim/

See you in Mara!

notes.title: UPDATE: Fast travel and additional crafting points
notes.notes:
Dear players,

A week ago we released Summer in Mara. During this week, you give us your feedback regarding different issues and ideas for us to work on and improve. 

We heard you and we want to use your feedback to improve Summer in Mara. In this update we implemented two features that will improve the experience of the game:


  Fast travel: Now Koa can travel immediately to any island that you have discovered previously. This way, you don't have to go from quadrant to quadrant, avoiding loading screens.

  Crafting and cooking. We thought it's a good idea to let Koa craft and cook in other islands, near to the main characters. Now you can craft/cook in Taka's restaurant, Akaji forge and Dunna's island.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/d2db6b5959f554769fb0f0db27e6d6a7095f8500.png

We hope these improvements help you during the game. Please, keep sharing your feedback and feel free to give us your opinion.

See you in Mara,
Chibig.

notes.title: Demo Launch & Release Date
notes.notes:
We have some good news.

 We just launch a prologue version of the game for free on Steam. You can just follow this link and try the beginning of this adventure. Next month, we’ll release it as well for Nintendo Switch. This is completely free, for everyone, and you can stream it and share it with whoever you want. The demo is just the tutorial so you know how to play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/6139eceaef2c5c620ed45d764ba2ab163c93d7f0.jpg

By the way, another thing: Summer in Mara will come out for Nintendo Switch, PC & Mac on June 16th. That’s right, we have an official release date! It’s been a long, long way and we’re so sorry for all the delays and changes, but we’ve done it thanks to you and now we’re just three weeks away from the release! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/ab2c8474fd99fffa70173bbb612a58ccf4b5ddb1.png

One last thing.

Caro is one of our artists. You can see her amazing 2D art as the portraits of the characters from the game, among many other things. Now, Caro is making a crowdfunding on her own!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/8387dc81842fee26e4039c52a670d23aad6cda17.jpg

Crepanquine is a fantasy, horror and drama comic inspired in the art of the famous animated Japanese films such as Perfect Blue and Howl's Moving Castle. It tells the story of the legendary Curse, a disease that transforms the index finger of its victims into parasitic magic wands. Our protagonists, the apathetic Rino and the lighthearted Xental will try to cure their loved ones of the disease. However, unbeknownst to them, higher forces will hinder their progress as they have a completely different purpose for the people living in Crepanquine.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/4c4b20d4bae1dc5bc84c6b17cdc3f9d5d96c97a0.jpg

If you have never heard about Crepanquine,don't worry! They also have a reward with an omnibus so you would not miss a thing about this story!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/ca7cc73ff5be52f3a42b05daf7266076a76c96b7.jpg

You can support Caro and Crepanquine here. 

See you in Mara on June 16th!
